responsibility: Implements lowering of Rust pattern syntax from AST into HIR pattern nodes. It translates identifier, wildcard, tuple, tuple-struct, struct, literal, grouped, reference, range, and path-based patterns, including conversion of tuple/range substructures through shared base helpers and registration of HIR pattern, location, and reverse node mappings. This file is the pattern counterpart to expression and type lowering, owning match/let destructuring structure rather than expression semantics.
same_name_distinction: Implements the pattern-lowering visitor methods that build concrete HIR pattern nodes and insert their mappings and locations; rust-ast-lower-pattern.h only exposes the ASTLoweringPattern interface and supported overrides.
